title: Candidate dashboard never rendered - candidates see 'This dashboard is coming soon.'
steps:
1. Register or log in as a candidate (role student).
2. Observe the page after login.
expected: Candidate dashboard (profile stats, application tracker, open jobs).
actual: Only the text 'This dashboard is coming soon.' Every candidate feature (profile, search, apply, track, withdraw) is unreachable from the UI.
root_cause: main.jsx renders <Company/> for companies and a placeholder for everyone else. Student.jsx was imported (commit 2cf8825) but never rendered.
fix: Render <Student/> for role 'student' through a small Dashboard component.

title: Company job cards have no Edit/Delete buttons and no status filter
steps:
1. Log in as a company with listings.
2. Look at the job cards and filter bar.
expected: Each card shows Details, Edit and Delete; an Active/Closed filter is visible.
actual: Only 'Details' on each card; no status filter. Edit/Delete reachable only through the details dialog.
root_cause: Commit a7ac198 made JobBrowser show company actions only when mode === 'company', but Company.jsx was never updated to pass mode.

title: NoSQL operator injection in POST /api/applications 'internship' field (OWASP A03)
steps: POST /api/applications as a candidate with body {"internship": {"$ne": null}}
expected: 400 - invalid job id; the database is not queried with attacker-controlled operators.
actual: 201 - Mongoose passes {$ne:null} through as a query operator; the candidate applies to whichever active job is found first.
root_cause: req.body.internship is used directly in Internship.findOne({_id: ...}); Mongoose does not sanitise operator objects (sanitizeFilter is off).
fix: Accept only a string that is a valid ObjectId; otherwise 400 'Choose a valid job'.

title: No brute-force protection on login (OWASP A07)
steps: Send 30 POST /api/auth/login requests with wrong passwords for one account.
expected: Requests are throttled (429) after a small number of failures.
actual: All 30 return 401; unlimited guessing is possible.
root_cause: No rate limiting or lockout was designed for the auth endpoints.
fix: In-memory limiter per IP+email: 10 failures per 15 min -> 429 with Retry-After; reset on success.

title: Re-applying after withdrawing fails with a generic 409 error
steps:
1. Apply to a job.
2. Withdraw the application.
3. Click 'Apply now' on the same job (the UI offers it again).
expected: Application is submitted again (or a clear explanation is shown).
actual: 409 'A record with these details already exists' toast.
root_cause: Client and server disagreed on the rule: client excludes withdrawn applications from appliedIds, but the server relies on a unique (student, internship) index and always inserts a new document.
fix: Server checks for a previous application: open -> 409 'You have already applied to this job'; withdrawn -> reopen the same record as 'submitted' with a timeline entry.

title: Login is CPU-bound: 50 concurrent logins take ~13 s each and stall other requests
steps: Load test with 50 users logging in at the same moment.
expected: Login p95 < 2 s; other endpoints unaffected.
actual: Login avg 13 302 ms (all HTTP 200); /api/health max 3 145 ms during the burst.
root_cause: bcryptjs (pure JS) compare at cost 12 = 266 ms on the event loop; 50 x 266 ms = 13.3 s, serialised.
fix: Recommended: native bcrypt/argon2 (thread pool) and/or Node cluster; re-test with JMeter login storm.

title: Malformed or oversized JSON body returns 500 instead of 400/413
steps: POST /api/auth/register with body '{bad json' or a 120 KB body.
actual: 500 'Something went wrong on the server' and a stack trace in the server log.
root_cause: errorHandler did not recognise body-parser errors (type entity.parse.failed / entity.too.large).
fix: Map those error types to 400 and 413.

title: Server accepts a listing deadline in the past (client blocks it)
steps: POST /api/internships as a company with deadline = yesterday.
root_cause: Rule implemented only in the client (JobForm.jsx), not in the server validator.
fix: TDD cycle 1: checkDeadline(value, now) in validateInternship.

title: API lets a candidate withdraw an offered/rejected/withdrawn application
steps: PATCH /api/applications/:id/withdraw on an application with status 'offered'.
root_cause: Rule enforced only by hiding the button in the UI.
fix: TDD cycle 2: rules.js canWithdraw(); status lists derived from the model.

title: Framework fingerprint and missing security headers (OWASP A05)
expected: No X-Powered-By; X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff; X-Frame-Options: DENY.
root_cause: Express defaults kept; no helmet or equivalent.

title: limit=0 returns the default page size (12) instead of the minimum (1)
root_cause: parseInt('0') || 12 treats 0 as missing because 0 is falsy.
fix: intOr() helper falls back only on NaN; clamp then applies.

title: Dialogs cannot be closed with the Escape key
steps: Open Job details (or any dialog) and press Escape.
actual: Dialog stays open; only the X or a click outside closes it.
root_cause: Modal has role=dialog but no keyboard handler.
fix: useEffect keydown listener calls onClose on Escape.

title: 'Create account' / 'Sign in' switch not reachable by keyboard
steps: On the login page, press Tab repeatedly.
actual: The link is skipped (anchor without href is not focusable).

title: Boolean/array values accepted as numbers (GPA, openings, minimum GPA)
Any application status can follow any other (e.g. rejected -> interview)
expected: Only allowed transitions (needs a product decision).
fix: Define allowed transitions in rules.js (product decision needed).

title: 'Your profile is matched against N opportunities' but no matching exists
steps: Log in as a candidate and read the dashboard header.
expected: Shown number reflects matching, or wording says 'open opportunities'.
actual: N is just the count of active jobs; the Match model is never used.
root_cause: Matching engine planned (models.js Match) but not implemented.
fix: Implement scoring, or change the wording.

title: Companies have no UI to see or manage applicants
steps: Log in as a company with applications.
expected: A list of applicants with status actions.
actual: No applicant view; API GET /applications and PATCH status exist but are unused by the client.
root_cause: Feature not built in the client.
fix: Add an applicants panel using the existing API.

title: Application stage bar has no labels
expected: Each segment labelled (Submitted, Reviewing, Shortlisted, Interview, Offered).
fix: Add labels or a tooltip / aria-label per segment.

title: An expired listing cannot be edited (e.g. closed) without changing its deadline
component: UI JobForm.jsx validate(); API validators (after BUG-08 fix)
steps:
1. Company has a listing whose deadline has passed.
2. Edit -> set Status = Closed -> Save.
actual: Client error 'Deadline cannot be in the past'; the API applies the same rule to updates since the BUG-08 fix.
root_cause: Past-deadline rule applied to unchanged deadlines on edit.
fix: Validate the deadline only when it is new or changed (client: compare with job.deadline; server: compare with stored value on PUT).
